  REPORTS - CITY MANAGER. The City Manager, Artie Fields congratulated the
  Rams, and the City of Inglewood for winning the Super Bowl. He thanked the staff for
  their efforts in making the weekend safe and enjoyable for visitors who traveled to the
  City of Inglewood from across the globe.

  REPORTS – CITY CLERK. The City Clerk, Aisha L. Thompson, thanked the staff for
  putting on the “Taste of Inglewood”. She also thanked Keokia and David for
  providing entertainment at the other stage of the event. She expressed her pride that the
  community came together and she was happy to take part in the event. The  City Clerk
  stated her mother was delighted with the results and congratulated the City of  Inglewood on
  a job well done. Furthermore, she thanked Mr. Roosevelt and his crew for keeping the streets of
  Inglewood clean during and after the “Taste of Inglewood. She  reported the next redistricting
  public hearing will be held on March 1, 2022, at the  hour of 2:00 pm. Additionally, she
  reported this year's theme for Black History Month is  black health and wellness, which led
  her to pay tribute to all the health care professionals who work tirelessly to keep everyone
  healthy. Finally, she congratulated the Rams for winning the Super Bowl and closed with a
  quote that stated, "Yesterday's  perspective of Inglewood is not the same as today's
  perspective."
